watch.summary: The streamer laughs hysterically while watching a Valorant esports coach aggressively slam a giant red timeout button.

beats.what: The streamer watches footage of a Valorant coach preparing to hit a button.
The streamer bursts into laughter as the graphic displays 'TIMEOUT' after the slam.
The streamer jokes that Valorant designed the button to be big, red, and shiny just to tempt angry coaches.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Valorant knew what they were doing when they decided to make that button red, shiny, and large bro
watch.why: The visual slapstick of a coach aggressively pounding a giant red button is universally understood. The streamer's energetic laugh and commentary about the button being designed as anger bait elevate the moment.
